title: FNaF Collectible Cards Mod
description: Adds Five Nights at Freddy's Collectible Cards to Minecraft!
body:
# Collect Them All!

Bring the world of **Five Nights at Freddy's** into Minecraft by collecting character cards!

This mod adds a collectible card system featuring characters from **FNaF 1–5**. Open card packs, collect your favorite animatronics, and try to complete your collection.

## Features

* Craftable card packs.
* Right-click a pack to open it.
* Receive **1–3 random collectible cards** from every pack.
* Includes characters from **Five Nights at Freddy's 1–5**.
* Randomized drops make collecting every card a fun challenge.

Whether you're a Minecraft player looking for a new collectible or a Five Nights at Freddy's fan wanting to collect your favorite characters, this mod adds a simple and fun collecting experience to your world.

## Planned Features

* More FNaF characters from later games.
* More cards added with future updates.
* Additional ways to obtain card packs.
* Improved card artwork and designs.

## Feedback

I'm not a professional artist, so some card textures are still a work in progress. If you'd like to help improve the artwork or have suggestions, feel free to leave feedback!
